name_input: K L HITECH SECURE PRINT LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/kl-hi-tech-secure-print-limited) shows a dated export row: "2026-02-20 | KL HI-TECH SECURE PRINT LIMITED. | OOREDOO TUNISIA SA | Prepaid Cards CARTE DE RECHARGE 25DT QRC(10in1)1 Outer Boxes Contain 5,000 Pinseach- | HYDERABAD ACC INHYD4, India | TUNIS, TUNISIA | 49019900 | 9861139" — i.e. shipment date 2026-02-20, destination Tunisia, HS 49019900, B/L no. 9861139. Page header states "Total Shipments 701 Records detected", "Trading Partners 23 Known counterparties", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-25". Buyer list on the same page names repeat export counterparties: ETHIO TELECOM (44 shipments), TELMA SA Madagascar (21), INTECHCARD LLC Russia (29), BHUTAN LOTTERY LIMITED (22), DIGICEL TONGA LTD (12). Source counter vs rows actually seen: page claims 701 total shipments, but only 5 individual dated rows were rendered in the free view (4 of them imports into India, 1 export).
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs rows with destination, HS code and B/L number exist, and the counterparty list shows recurring export buyers across Ethiopia, Madagascar, Russia, Bhutan and Tonga. Note the declared HS 854231 is only partially consistent: the 2026-02-25 row (HS 85423100, KONA I CO., LTD. -> KL HI-TECH, Seoul Incheon -> Hyderabad ACC, B/L 7736761, 'KONA2 D5450 6 PIN Gold Modules (Integrated Circuits)') is an IMPORT of chips, not an export; the confirmed export row is HS 49019900 (prepaid cards / recharge cards). Per project rules this is not a rejection ground — the company's actual trade HS is 49019900 (printed cards) plus 85423100 on the import side; verdict would be accepted_hs_corrected. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be verified: zaubacorp, thecompanycheck, trademo, eximpedia and volza all returned HTTP 403, and web search was unavailable (searx connection refused / DuckDuckGo timeout / Google 429). Domestic status therefore recorded as unknown with null evidence rather than guessed; no turnover or export-volume figure is asserted here because the free view does not expose values. Registered address seen on the page: 22-23, ANRICH INDUSTRIAL ESTATE BOLLARAM (Telangana/Hyderabad area, consistent with the Hyderabad ACC port lanes).
